propositions: When a Jira issue moves between projects its KEY changes but its numeric ID does not; bindings keyed on the mutable KEY can silently detach if the moved_issue_key table is not updated by third-party movers, leaving the old key unresolvable while the issue still exists.

The fix captures the immutable numeric jira_id alongside the key in bindings and falls back to resolving by ID when a key lookup fails, re-keying the binding to the issue's current key and updating the reverse index in the same operation.

The remediation is additive to the key-based binding identity rather than re-keying the store, preserving Cloud bridge semantics and requiring no migration; entries without a recorded jira_id degrade safely to pre-fix behavior.

On a real Jira Data Center 8.17.1 instance, GET /rest/api/2/issue/{oldKey} for a moved issue returns status 200 with the body carrying the NEW key, confirming the stale key resolves through moved_issue_key when that table is intact.

A genuine issue deletion must still retire the binding even when a numeric ID is recorded, distinguishing a true deletion from a move; a moved issue resolves by its immutable numeric ID and answers with its current key.
